commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo RUN
date -u
echo PROC_SANITY
ps -eo pid,user,args --width 300 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'ragin.server_v2|server_v2.py|python3.*ragin' | grep -v grep | head -n 20 || true
echo LISTEN_SANITY
if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ss -tulpn 2>/dev/null | grep -iE ':8443|python3' || true
else
  echo ss_not_present
fi
echo ENV_SANITY
if [ -f /etc/ragin/server.env ]; then
  echo ENV_FILE=/etc/ragin/server.env
  grep -E '^(RAGIN_MTLS|RAGIN_BIND_HOST|PORT|RAGIN_LLM|GATEWAY_URL|RAGIN_REQUIRE_AUTH|RAGIN_MAX_REQUEST|RAGIN_HOST_FICTION|RAGIN_DON_MODEL|RAGIN_HISOKA_MODEL|RAGIN_HISOKA_TIMEOUT|OPENROUTER_API_KEY|RAGIN_LLM_API_KEY)=' /etc/ragin/server.env 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's/^(RAGIN_LLM_API_KEY|OPENROUTER_API_KEY|RAGIN_LLM_API_KEY)=.*/REDACTED_KEY_ENV=yes/' || true
else
  echo ENV_MISSING=/etc/ragin/server.env
fi
echo RUNTIME_TLS_PATHS
for p in /run/ragin/tls /run/ragin /run/ragin/tls/server.crt /run/ragin/tls/server.key /run/ragin/tls/ca.crt; do
  if [ -e "$p" ]; then
    if [ -d "$p" ]; then
      echo PATH_TYPE=directory PATH=$p exists=yes
    else
      echo PATH_TYPE=file PATH=$p exists=yes
    fi
  else
    echo PATH_TYPE=$p exists=no
  fi
done
echo SOURCE_PROVENANCE
for d in /opt/ragin /app /srv /etc/ragin; do
  if [ -d "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/ragin/server_v2.py" ]; then
    echo SOURCE_DIR=$d
    ls -la "$d/ragin/server_v2.py" 2>/dev/null || true
    echo SOURCE_HASH=$(sha256sum "$d/ragin/server_v2.py" 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1 || echo hash_failed)
    break
  fi
done
echo DONE
